title: The Northernmost Padang Besar 22KM & 12KM 2026 Review: What the Night Run Was Like
meta_description: Northernmost Padang Besar 2026 review: 900+ runners from five countries on a 10pm-4am night run through Chuping Valley on 8 August, with cultural shows.
dek: Malaysia's northernmost road race is a night run on the Thai border. The 2026 edition, on 8 August, drew more than 900 runners. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Northernmost Padang Besar is a small, distinctive night race on the Malaysia-Thailand border. The 2026 edition, part of the Festival Padang Besar, drew more than 900 runners of many backgrounds, including runners from five countries, and ran from 10pm to 4am on Saturday 8 August [1]. The 22 km route took in Padang Besar town, Chuping Valley, Felda Rimba Emas and Kampung Kok Mak, and runners were treated to a lion dance and Siamese, Malay and Indian drumming along the way [1]. If you want an unusual overnight race in Perlis with a multicultural border-town feel, it is worth the trip north.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: More than 900 runners took part, including runners from five countries [1]. The race was part of the Festival Padang Besar 2026 and was organised by Putra Trail Running Club [1].
It is a night race: runners were on the course from 10pm to 4am [1]. There were two distances, 22 km and 12 km.

sections.heading: The Route and the Atmosphere
paragraphs: The 22 km route ran through Padang Besar town, Chuping Valley, Felda Rimba Emas and Kampung Kok Mak [1]. At the Padang Besar roundabout, runners passed cultural performances: a lion dance, Siamese long drums, silat drums and Indian urumi melam drumming [1].
The festival director congratulated the runners and expressed the hope that the event would become a recreational sports icon for the north of Malaysia [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a race that feels different from a city half marathon, yes. A night run through a border town and the Chuping Valley, with drummers from three communities along the way, is not a common combination.
Plan for running in the dark: a head torch, something reflective and a way to get back to your bed at 4am.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.answer: A night race in Padang Besar, Perlis, on the Malaysia-Thailand border, held as part of the Festival Padang Besar. In 2026 it ran from 10pm to 4am on 8 August, with 22 km and 12 km distances and more than 900 runners.
